Label: Onboard First
Rationale: Easy-to-medium collection with critical importance. Backbone of IT-to-OT crossing and remote-access-abuse detection - the two most common OT compromise paths.

Label: Onboard Next
Rationale: High or critical importance but harder to instrument (PLC, Safety Controller) or lower urgency/volume (Historian, Router). Safety Controller events always page out.

Label: Fill Coverage Gaps
Rationale: High value but high engineering effort. Network Traffic is the single most important source for protocol-level Sigma detection but demands SPAN/TAP architecture and DPI tuning first.

Label: Do Not Collect Directly
Rationale: State already represented indirectly via PLC/RTU telemetry and historian; native collection adds cost for near-zero marginal detection value.
